select

select

select
from CHB_MONTH_REPORT_SUB_TEMPLATE where STATUS = 'E' and REPORTTYPE = #{reporttype,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by ORDERNO

select position.PROD_ID prodId, position.ASSETVALUE_B assetvalueB, position.TERMS terms, position.SUNASSETTYPE sunassettype, position.SUNASSETTYPE2 sunassettype2, info.IS_TRANSFER isFprod, asset.ISSUE_MODE issueMode from CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION position inner join CHB_PRD_BASEINFO info on info.PROD_ID = position.PROD_ID left join CHB_ASSET_INFO asset on asset.ASSET_CODE = position.ASSET_CODE and info.STATUS in ('M', 'E') and info.PROFIT_TYPE = '03' where position.ENDDATE >= #{firstday, jdbcType=DATE} and position.ENDDATE <= #{lastday, jdbcType=DATE}
